training.title: Training Ground
training.connectingDetail: You enter alone and training starts as soon as it is ready.
training.guide: Use the floor pads to change tagger, skill, or reset state, then test against targets and walls.

guide.title: How to Play
guide.intro: Stay alive inside the shrinking storm, evade the tagger, and pass the role to another runner at the decisive moment.

demo.title: What each skill does
demo.manualMotion: Reduced motion is enabled, so a still frame is shown. Press play to watch it once.

dash.body: A big sustained speed boost. It is a run, not a teleport, so walls still stop you — but you cover more ground than a flash.

flash.body: Teleports you in the direction you face. It crosses walls — walls along the path are ignored and only the landing spot matters. Shortest cooldown of the three.

exhaust.body: Slows everyone inside the circle, not one chosen target — positioning matters more than aim. It is an area skill, so it has the longest cooldown and briefly slows you too.

switch.body: Only works near the current tagger. The runner you pick becomes the new tagger; you stay a runner and get Frenzy to escape.

tagger.body: The tagger has a red body and a flag above their head. Getting caught by them knocks you out on the spot.

rules.title: Survive to the end
rules.tag: The tagger catching you knocks you out on the spot. It is the only way anyone leaves a match.
rules.storm: The storm keeps closing in. You cannot step outside it — it pushes you back — so everyone is forced together.
rules.switch: Switch only works near the current tagger. The runner you pick becomes the new tagger; you stay a runner.
rules.winners: The last two players alive win together.

training.hint: Try every skill and bump into things. Nothing here counts for or against you.

rules.becomeTagger: Becoming the tagger grants {{frenzyPercent}}% extra move speed for {{frenzySeconds}}s (Frenzy) — at match start, when switched onto you, and on a forced rotation alike.
rules.chainTag: Knocking someone out while frenzied extends Frenzy by {{tagBonusSeconds}}s and adds another {{tagBonusPercent}}% speed. Chain catches and you keep getting faster.
rules.switchBonus: Landing a switch grants the caster the same Frenzy, so you have a moment to run after handing the role off.
rules.demoted: Losing the tagger role to a switch slows you by {{demotedPercent}}% for {{demotedSeconds}}s, so you cannot immediately switch it straight back.
rules.nearCooldown: Runners within {{nearRadiusTiles}} tiles of the tagger recover skill cooldowns {{nearBonusPercent}}% faster. The riskier your position, the more often you get to act.
rules.rotate: If the tagger has not changed for {{rotateSeconds}}s, a random runner becomes the tagger. It keeps a stalled match moving.
